name: Pym Doughnut Sundae & Nano Dobos Torta
whyItWorks: Soft glazed doughnut + dulche de leche ice cream or layered sponge/chocolate ganache (Nano Dobos Torta) deliver smooth, zero-fiber sweet calories.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pym Doughnut Sundae, Nano Dobos Torta, or Marvel Ice Cream Sundae (with a Lactaid pill). Strictly avoid the Quantum Key Lime Pie and Double Blueberry Cheesecake (lemon shortcrust) if following the citrus guardrail.
watchOuts: Double Blueberry Cheesecake (lemon crust + berry skins)
